audit.interpretation: O(1) is an asymptotic order, not equality of finite-record estimator means at all P.

P1_short.approximation: Asymptotic spectral equation, no finite-window cross-bin/boundary-nuisance corrections.

P1_long.approximation: Asymptotic spectral equation, no finite-window cross-bin/boundary-nuisance corrections.

P8.approximation: Asymptotic spectral equation, no finite-window cross-bin/boundary-nuisance corrections.

initialization_diagnostic.description: Same cached P1 data, initial poles at direct population pseudo-true values, linear coefficients reinitialized, tolerance tightened 1e-5 to 1e-6; diagnostic only.

conclusion: No P1-specific implementation mismatch found. Lengthening one period restores a large positive direct-method bias. Short-record nonlinear/nuisance estimation effects mask the population bias; no claim of exact finite-sample agreement or decomposition of those effects.
